'''Pocket Monsters HGSS''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター HG・SS編''') is a shōnen [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. It is a sequel to the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]], [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]], and {{OBP|Pocket Monsters DP|Kosaku Anakubo}} manga series and takes place before the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}} manga. The plot follows the adventures of {{PPM|Red}} and his Pokémon as they go back to [[Johto]]. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
